semiconductor_relevance: Medium — EAYUAN METAL INDUSTRIAL CO.,LTD. manufactures high-end valves that are essential for fluid handling and control in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: EAYUAN METAL INDUSTRIAL CO.,LTD. specializes in the production of stainless steel valves, including a variety of types suitable for semiconductor applications. With over 40 years of experience, they provide high-quality solutions for fluid handling, temperature, humidity, and contamination control in semiconductor facilities.
capabilities: Manufacturing of over 700 types of stainless steel valves
Production of cryogenic valves for extreme temperature applications
Pneumatic and manual operation options for fluid control systems

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is based in Taiwan and has established a strong global supply and marketing network.
